hooks.name: safe-ship-pre
hooks.description: Safe Ship (disabled by default). Blocks git push and deploy commands until a test run exited 0 after the last edit. Turn on with: python scripts/safe_ship.py enable (writes an untracked local copy). See docs/SAFE_SHIP.md.

hooks.name: safe-ship-post
hooks.description: Safe Ship (disabled by default). Records a green test run (exit code 0) for safe-ship-pre.
